SELECT o.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items AS oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE oi.is_drink_item = 1
GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
